top_signals.title: Fitch’s Private Credit Default Rate Hit Record in Second Quarter
top_signals.summary: The default rate across 1,300 US private debt borrowers tracked by Fitch Ratings rose to a record high in the second quarter, according to a report released Thursday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Aon Keeps Margin Edge as Industry Tailwinds Fade
top_signals.summary: Aon CEO Edmund Reese said that despite rising geopolitical risk, customers want to understand how to protect their assets as they continue to grow and invest. Reese said that his company has been investing in tools and data to help the client base better understand their exposure as risk factors intermingle for the business community.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Amazon's Zoox to begin charging for rides in Las Vegas after clearing NHTSA hurdle
top_signals.summary: The exemption allows Zoox to operate up to 2,500 vehicles annually for two years, subject to "enhanced, adaptable" oversight conditions.

top_signals.title: LG to Ban Residential Proxies from Smart TV Apps
top_signals.summary: The home appliance giant LG Electronics USA said this week it plans to suspend any apps built for its smart TVs that turn one's television into an always-on residential proxy node. The move comes less than a month after researchers found that more than 42 percent of games and other apps available for download on LG's webOS store allow unknown third-parties to route their Internet traffic through a user's TV.
